messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: region eu-west8 has stopped reporting heartbeats for control-plane (detected by heartbeat-aggregator).
Alice M.: seeing same, ~30% of gpu nodes unregistered, API latency spiking.
Ben K.: are requests failing or being queued?
Alice M.: most requests are 503 from the edge, traffic manager shows automatic failover to eu-west3 kicking in but capacity is low there.
Carla S.: provisioning jobs to warm additional GPUs in eu-west3 are failing with registry timeouts. getting: 
```
Error: image pull failed: registry.eu: i/o timeout
```
Dmitri V.: hmm could be cross-region registry flap. any networking blips in backbone? traceroutes?
Ben K.: running quick check, bgp status looks ok for eu-west8->backbone, but lots of packet loss to registry.eu from that region.
Alice M.: impact: hosted API p95 latency > 4s; some customers hitting quota errors as retry logic gives up. Dedicated clusters in eu-west8 still up but control-plane APIs to create jobs are timed out.
oncall: tagged paging for infra-sre and network. escalation to ops in 10m if no mitigation.
Carla S.: workaround attempt: switching provisioning to fallback registry mirror in eu-west3, patching cluster template now. rolling command: `kubectl apply -f warm-pool-mirror.yaml --namespace=provisioning`.
Dmitri V.: also enabling forced routing: route-policy for traffic-manager to prefer us-east1 for non-eu customers to reduce load on eu-west3. doing a partial weight shift (eu-west3 40% -> us-east1 60%).
Ben K.: can we pin enterprise customers with eu SLAs to Dedicated pools so they don't get moved?
Alice M.: yes, switching enterprise routes off automatic failover for now, they stay on reserved pools in eu-west8 (if those pools are still healthy). but control-plane ops for reserved can still be impacted.
Carla S.: provisioning patch applied, warm pools starting but at lower NVMe throughput; startup logs show slower init. ETA ~12-18m to get 50% of target.
Dmitri V.: creating short-term capacity relief: 1) enable quantized model variants for text-generation for non-enterprise to reduce GPU memory pressure, 2) temporarily increase batch window from 40ms->120ms for cheaper throughput. I'll push config via runtime flag.
Alice M.: pushed runtime flags. monitoring token usage and queue depth. early signs: drop in memory pressure on eu-west3 nodes.
Ben K.: customer comms?
Alice M.: draft status page note: "Investigating partial control-plane and provisioning failures affecting eu-west8; automated failover in progress, traffic being rebalanced to other regions. Some customers may see elevated latency or provisioning delays." pinging comms to publish.
oncall: create incident doc in runbook and set severity to Sev2. assigning remediation owner to @Dmitri V. and network owner @Carla S.
Carla S.: escalated registry timeouts to provider NOC (ticket #INC-78432). provider notes degraded peering in eu-west8 -> registry.eu. waiting AOC.
Dmitri V.: if provider ETA > 30m, plan B: move registry mirror to a different provider region and update ignition images. prepping script to rebase AMIs.
Ben K.: what's the risk of evictions if we force more load to eu-west3?
Alice M.: moderate — we may hit OOM and preemption on spot-like nodes. already saw 3 model-worker evictions in the last 10m. I'll add preemption guards and bump on-demand instance counts in the warm pool.
Carla S.: warm-pool on-demand instances requested (+40), cloud accepted 10 immediately, remaining queued.
Dmitri V.: documented temporary routing config and rollback steps in incident doc. also adding a fallback policy in traffic-manager to use CPU-backed fallback for low-priority requests to buy time.
Alice M.: monitoring metrics: p95 latency improving slowly, error rate trending down from 8% -> 3%. provisioning queue length still high.
Ben K.: for longer term, we should consider cross-region replicated registries and a second provider for images. putting a ticket in infra backlog.
Carla S.: provider NOC back: partial peering restored, registry timeouts improving. warm pool now 62% of target.
Dmitri V.: preparing to scale down forced routing in 15m if trend continues. will leave quantization and batch config for another hour then revert.
Alice M.: good job team. keeping this open until eu-west8 control-plane stable for 30m. next update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
